timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi everyone, it's Sophia Rogan, you're a Miss Grand Indonesia 2021 and today I'm here at a hot spot for local street food from Indonesia and I'm gonna share with you all the delicious cuisine that we have to offer.
You got some brownies and ham than you thought, nice and light, nice!
I have washed my hands but i have to break it first!
Since I only have these rice habilets, I love those too I have a very busy day.
Someone Orion sends you something, look at this lunch box, i happened to hide it cold instead of feeling chilly after being around the house which I got it for dinner
We also got some sambal, which usually in Indonesia consists of chilies, ground up with onions or garlic or whatever herbs they may add.
Usually it's super yummy and there's different types of sambals there.
The best sambal is the sambal.
Okay, so now my food has arrived. I've got kanko, I've got some rice, tahou, tempeh.
I'm so hungry guys, so let's eat!
So hopefully we can dive together again next time. Bye!
